name: Greater Mark Of Healing
description: General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+, Mark of Healing Feat) You gain the following benefits. Additionally, when you cast Cure Wounds and roll dice to determine the number of Hit Points restored, you can treat any 1 or 2 on a roll as a 3.

features.name: Ability Score Increase
features.description: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20.

features.name: Improved Intuition
features.description: When you use the Medical Intuition benefit of your Mark of Healing feat, you can roll 1d6 instead of 1d4.

features.name: Improved Healing
features.description: You can now use the Healing Touch benefit of your Mark of Healing feat to cast Cure Wounds without using a spell slot a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.
